task: Produce the on-page SEO package for a magnesium glycinate product page: title tag, meta description, H1, and structured data. Target intent: people searching for magnesium for sleep/anxiety. Must follow on-page best practices and be technically valid.
reference: Excellent = title tag ~50-60 chars, primary keyword front-loaded, brand at end, not truncated; meta description ~150-155 chars, benefit + differentiator + soft CTA, includes keyword naturally; ONE H1 distinct from the title, descriptive; valid schema.org Product JSON-LD with name, brand, offers (price/availability/priceCurrency), and aggregateRating — and ideally a relevant FAQ. Technically correct (valid JSON-LD, no keyword stuffing, no duplicate H1). Bad = keyword-stuffed/over-length title, generic meta with no keyword or value, H1 identical to title or missing, and either no structured data or invalid/irrelevant schema.
